name: value-data-10k
note: Predeclared 2026-11-04 before any data (Jerry: 'help generate 10k games'). Value-head data only: 10,000 self-play games of the served planner_offer_accept (fresh seeds 2640000-2649999), no move decisions or playouts; every turn-start ('roll') and end-of-turn ('end_turn') position of every seat with 40 observation-only features, the served leaf and shared score, labelled with the final winner. Train = first 9,000 games, test = last 1,000; the test split is not read until a training config is committed. Runs on ultra from a frozen snapshot; copied back to runs/ on the mini.
